title: Choose a value
summary: Kotlin: Choose a value. Try a score of 3.
introduction: if can return a value. Both branches below produce a message.

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.

blocks.title: Choose a value

blocks.text: The true if condition chooses Pass as the value of message.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An if used as a value needs an else branch.
